dialogue_conversations.fallback_text: They have nothing to say right now.

nodes.text: Stand clear, wanderer. Justice has no quarrel with you unless you make one. Aid our cause, and we may speak again.

dialogue_conversations.fallback_text: They have nothing to say right now.

nodes.text: Your service has been noticed. The commander will receive you. Report to the eastern command post.

dialogue_conversations.fallback_text: They have nothing to say right now.

nodes.text: Keep walking unless you mean to settle a debt. Strike our enemies, and the Avengers will remember.

dialogue_conversations.fallback_text: They have nothing to say right now.

nodes.text: You have answered blood with blood. The commander wants your name. Report to the western command post.

dialogue_conversations.fallback_text: They have nothing to say right now.

choices.text: Justice without mercy only creates another wrong.

nodes.text: You fought your way to this command post. Before I place soldiers under your banner, tell me: what does justice demand?
Then carry the weight of every answer you demand. Welcome to the line.
A dangerous answer in this army—and perhaps the one it most needs. Welcome to the line.

dialogue_conversations.fallback_text: They have nothing to say right now.

nodes.text: Hold the line, Knight. Every life we protect is an answer stronger than steel.

dialogue_conversations.fallback_text: They have nothing to say right now.

choices.text: Every fallen Avenger is a debt that must be paid.
A debt that never ends is a chain. Someone must break it.

nodes.text: You spilled blood beside us and earned this audience. Before I trust you with soldiers, tell me: what is vengeance?
Then remember every name. An Avenger who forgets the fallen has already betrayed them.
Bold words. Find the end of this chain without abandoning our dead, and I may follow you there.

dialogue_conversations.fallback_text: They have nothing to say right now.

nodes.text: Do not let the fallen become numbers. Remember why you fight.

quests.completion_text: You chose justice through action. Now prove you can serve it with discipline.
quests.offer_text: Your actions have reached the commander's ears. Report to the Justice warfront command post.
quests.title: Report to Justice

quests.completion_text: You answered blood with vengeance. Now show us you have the strength to endure the war.
quests.offer_text: The commander knows what you did for our fallen. Report to the Avenger warfront command post.
quests.title: Report to Avenger
